Title: Public Preview of Azure Data Explorer capabilities to integrate deeper with ADLS Gen 2

Body.Content:
Make the most of your Azure Data Lake Store Gen 2 investments with Azure Data Explorer's latest capabilities in preview:

  • Query Over Data Lake: Customers will be able to query data from ADLS Gen2 without ingesting the data into Azure Data Explorer. Customers will be able to query historical data from their data lake and join it with the near-real-time data cached in Azure Data Explorer. 
  • Continuous data export: This feature writes CSV or Parquet files to the data lake, as data streams in via event hubs, IoT hubs, or any other path. It enables building analytical solution over fresh data and seamlessly fill the data lake.

Learn more by visiting our blog. To get started, see documentation.
